name: proto-file-outside-the-buf-modules
description: A schema file no buf.yaml module's path holds is read under its path from the target root and no import resolves to it, so it is published as any other; where a module holds a file of that same import path, it is shadowed by that file, as two files of one import path would share one schema_file: it publishes no declaration and a schema-unparsed note names it. Since a schema file not read cleanly, a shadowed one included, may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
